tools_helpful.evidence: Seeded 16 source files, triage labels, and inline TODOs; the mechanical namespace rewrite and MIGRATION-MAPPING seed worked cleanly (session-log ~turn 2).

Returned the correct IInitializeWithWindow file-picker pattern and DispatcherQueue.TryEnqueue threading replacement, which the agent applied to all pickers/threading sites without error (session-log ~turn 9).
Second run PASSed and drove the runtime smoke launch; it correctly flagged the still-copied MIGRATION-MAPPING rows on the first run.

tools_problematic.problem: The validator emits '[WARN] MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md exists with content but mapping has no defer rows' on a clean zero-deferral migration.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log validation output line ~4925; the two scripts disagree on the empty-defer sentinel.

tool_limitations.limitation: Does not inspect the copied source for `unsafe` usage, so the scaffold csproj lacks <AllowUnsafeBlocks> and the first build fails with CS0227.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Scan copied .cs for the `unsafe` keyword and auto-add <AllowUnsafeBlocks>true</AllowUnsafeBlocks> to the scaffold csproj at bootstrap.

special_apis.api: AudioGraph frame access (IMemoryBufferByteAccess / byte* / FrameInputNode / custom IBasicAudioEffect)
special_apis.special_handling: Requires C# `unsafe` blocks; the WinUI 3 scaffold csproj must set <AllowUnsafeBlocks>true</AllowUnsafeBlocks> or the build fails CS0227.

In WinUI 3 desktop there is no implicit active window; must call WinRT.Interop.InitializeWithWindow.Initialize(picker, WindowNative.GetWindowHandle(App.MainWindow)). Skill covered this and agent applied it to all 7 pickers with no error.

errors_encountered.error: CS0227: Unsafe code may only appear if compiling with /unsafe (CustomEffect.cs, Scenario3_FrameInputNode.xaml.cs)
errors_encountered.root_cause: AudioGraph frame-buffer code uses `unsafe`; scaffold csproj did not enable unsafe blocks.

errors_encountered.error: CS0103: The name 'Colors' does not exist in the current context
errors_encountered.root_cause: After the namespace rewrite, unqualified `Colors` lost its `using`. MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md mapping table already lists Windows.UI.Colors -> Microsoft.UI.Colors.
errors_encountered.fix: Added the color namespace using / qualified the reference in the scenario files.

errors_encountered.error: Validate FAIL: N rows still Status=copied
errors_encountered.root_cause: Agent had not flipped MIGRATION-MAPPING Status from copied to done as it finished each file; SKILL.md documents this explicitly.
errors_encountered.fix: Flipped all rows copied -> done and re-ran validation (PASS).

errors_encountered.error: Validate WARN: MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md exists with content but mapping has no defer rows
errors_encountered.root_cause: Initialize seeds DEFERRED.md with a '| (none) | — |' row; Validate expects the literal 'No items deferred' text.
errors_encountered.fix: None applied by agent (non-blocking WARN); this is a genuine skill self-inconsistency.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Build FAILED with simultaneous CS0227 (unsafe) and CS0103 (Colors) errors.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Scaffold csproj lacked AllowUnsafeBlocks; audio-buffer source needs unsafe.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Added AllowUnsafeBlocks and fixed color namespace.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 auto-adding <AllowUnsafeBlocks> when it detects `unsafe` in copied source.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Validate FAIL on Status=copied rows; then a lingering WARN about MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Status flip is a documented manual step (slip); the DEFERRED WARN is a script inconsistency.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Initialize seeding MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md with the 'No items deferred.' sentinel the validator expects.
